newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin, including its Osijek outpost for Monday, October 28.
* Of 12 active issues five were up, three were down and four were unchanged.
* Volume up at 2,061 shares, turnover also higher at 106,696 German marks.
* Biggest gainer and the most actively traded issue was hotelier Zlatni Rat, 40.6 percent up to 45 marks on volume of 381 shares.
* Biggest looser was another hotelier Istraturist which dropped 12.3 percent to 50 marks, selling 49 units.
